name: ai-accounting
prompt: Should we invest in an AI accounting startup?
evidence: The startup targets mid-market finance teams. Competitors include legacy accounting suites and newer automation vendors. Key diligence questions are retention, gross margin, acquisition cost, burn, runway, and compliance.

name: climate-software
prompt: Evaluate a climate software company that helps factories reduce energy use.
evidence: The product uses factory telemetry to identify energy savings. Alternatives include consultants and industrial monitoring platforms. Validate savings attribution, deployment time, contracts, gross margin, and customer payback.

name: healthcare-workflow
prompt: Assess whether to invest in an AI workflow tool for outpatient clinics.
evidence: The tool automates administrative workflows for outpatient clinics. Competitors include practice-management suites and specialized service vendors. Diligence should cover clinical safety boundaries, privacy, implementation effort, retention, pricing, and expansion.

name: developer-security
prompt: Review a developer security platform for a possible seed investment.
evidence: The platform scans source code and cloud configuration for security issues. Competitors include established application-security tools and open-source scanners. Validate false-positive rates, developer adoption, distribution, retention, gross margin, and platform dependency.
